description: This file defines types, constants, and data structures used for the Kubernetes scheduler extender API, including preemption, filtering, binding, and priority mechanisms.

classes.name: ExtenderPreemptionResult
classes.description: Represents the result returned by preemption phase of extender.

classes.name: ExtenderPreemptionArgs
classes.description: Arguments needed by the extender to preempt pods on nodes.

classes.name: Victims
classes.description: Represents a group of pods expected to be preempted and the count of PodDisruptionBudget violations.

classes.name: MetaPod
classes.description: Identifier for a v1.Pod, using UID.

classes.name: MetaVictims
classes.description: Represents victims with only Pod identifiers and PDB violation count.

classes.name: ExtenderArgs
classes.description: Arguments needed by the extender to filter/prioritize nodes for a pod.

classes.name: FailedNodesMap
classes.description: Filtered out nodes with failure messages.

classes.name: ExtenderFilterResult
classes.description: Results of a filter call to an extender, including filtered nodes and failure info.

classes.name: ExtenderBindingArgs
classes.description: Arguments for binding a pod to a node via an extender.

classes.name: ExtenderBindingResult
classes.description: Result of binding a pod to a node from an extender.

classes.name: HostPriority
classes.description: Represents the priority score of a host for scheduling.
